props.name: children
props.description: The list so far. InfiniteScroll adds nothing around it but the footer.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Fetch the next page. Resolve with how many items arrived, so the count can be announced; reject to show the error.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether there is anything left to load. When false the footer says so.

props.name: mode
props.description: `auto` loads when the end scrolls into view and keeps the button as a fallback; `button` loads only on request.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: How far ahead of the end to start loading, as an IntersectionObserver root margin.

props.name: itemNoun
props.description: What the items are, for announcements — "3 more results loaded". Singular form.

props.name: endMessage
props.description: Shown once `hasMore` is false. Pass null to show nothing.
